description: This file defines a PHP interface 'Zend_Http_UserAgent_Device' for implementing device detection and feature querying within the Zend Framework's HTTP user agent package.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Device
classes.description: An interface that specifies the methods for interacting with device features, browser info, and capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor allowing injection of user agent string, server array, and configuration array, or seeding with cached values.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Static method to attempt matching the user agent string to device signatures, returning an array or boolean.

methods.name: getAllFeatures
methods.description: Retrieve all features of the device as an array.

methods.name: getAllGroups
methods.description: Retrieve all feature groups associated with the device.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Check whether the device has a specific feature.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Get the value of a specific device feature.

methods.name: getBrowser
methods.description: Retrieve the browser type.

methods.name: getBrowserVersion
methods.description: Retrieve the browser version.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieve features associated with a specific group.

methods.name: getImageFormatSupport
methods.description: Retrieve supported image formats.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieve supported image types.

methods.name: getMaxImageHeight
methods.description: Get the maximum supported image height.

methods.name: getMaxImageWidth
methods.description: Get the maximum supported image width.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenHeight
methods.description: Get physical screen height of the device.

methods.name: getPhysicalScreenWidth
methods.description: Get physical screen width of the device.

methods.name: getPreferredMarkup
methods.description: Retrieve the preferred markup type.

methods.name: getUserAgent
methods.description: Get the user agent string.

methods.name: getXhtmlSupportLevel
methods.description: Get supported XHTML level.

methods.name: hasFlashSupport
methods.description: Determine if device supports Flash.

methods.name: hasPdfSupport
methods.description: Determine if device supports PDF.

methods.name: hasPhoneNumber
methods.description: Check if device has an associated phone number.

methods.name: httpsSupport
methods.description: Check if device supports HTTPS.
